lines: Revenue was $23.3 million, up 27% year over year.
A record 115,000 analyses were performed, up 22% year over year; U.S. analysis volume grew 60% and Liquid Biopsy revenue grew 80%.
IFRS net loss was $22.4 million; adjusted EBITDA loss improved 27% to $8.8 million.
2026 revenue guidance was raised to $94-$96 million, with adjusted EBITDA loss guidance of $29-$32 million.
Revenue $24.267 million (+25% YoY); reported gross margin 65.7%; adjusted gross margin 72.8%.
IFRS net loss $20.272 million; adjusted EBITDA loss $6.071 million (31% improvement YoY).
118,000 SOPHiA DDM analyses (+19% YoY); 4,200 liquid biopsy analyses (+100% or more YoY).
551 core genomics customers; 30 new core genomics customers signed in Q3.
2026 revenue expected at upper end of $94-$96 million guidance; adjusted EBITDA loss guidance $29-$32 million.
